method: NAIVE. Straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Executive Condominium Housing Scheme Act 1996 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation in force from 1 December 2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/ECHSA1996.txt

checks.command: l4 run ec-cases.l4 ; l4 run ec-death-and-transfer-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 3 to 13 - the whole Act except s 1 (short title), s 2 (interpretation) and s 14 (the Minister's general power). ec-act.l4 has the four disqualifying grounds and the section 5(9) saving, the developer's notice and the 14-day appeal, cancellation on the applicant's death, the two-window transfer prohibition and the nine compulsory-acquisition grounds. ec-death-and-transfer.l4 has the regulation power and what it leaves to regulations (s 3), the appointment of developers (s 4), transmission on the owner's death within 10 years with its three clocks (s 8), the resale premium (s 10), service (s 11), protection from liability (s 12) and transfer to a non-citizen (s 13). The minimum occupation period, the s 3(2) regulations and the s 13(1) excepting circumstances remain facts supplied and were not retrieved.
